ai_review.summary: Rough audience recording but stellar jams on Easy Wind, The Other One/Cryptical and Turn On Your Lovelight
ai_review.review: The reviewer notes that the tape suffers from rough sound quality, yet praises the performance as “beyond category,” especially highlighting the Easy Wind, The Other One/Cryptical sequence and the extended Turn On Your Lovelight jam. While the audio is a drawback, the musical moments are considered gems.

ai_rating.rationale: Only one review; it rates the recording poorly (0 stars) but lauds the musical content heavily, resulting in a mid‑range overall rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewer describes sound as rough and low‑fidelity, though some musical detail still shines through.
